plain.li: [spark:fulfilled] I watched {NAME} do it and couldn't stop thinking about it afterward. I'm going to master {SKILL} too.
[inherited] Right up to the end, {NAME} was getting better every week. I'm going to {GOAL} and pick up where {NAME} left off.
Before I die, I'm going to be truly good at {SKILL}. Not decent, good.
The others each have a thing they're known for. I'd like {SKILL} to be mine.
[old] I've been passable at {SKILL} for decades. I'd like to die a master. There's still time, if I hurry.

blunt.li: I'm going to master {SKILL}. Anyone who wants to laugh can watch me do it.

cheerful.li: I'm going to be amazing at {SKILL}! Starting today, right after breakfast.

cold.li: Mastery of {SKILL} will take years of practice. I have years.

warm.li: I'd like to be good enough at {SKILL} to teach it to the children someday.

plain.li: Someone asked me today how I do it, and I realized I didn't have to think about the answer. I've mastered {SKILL}.
Years of practice, and today it all came together. I'm a master of {SKILL} now.

warm.li: I've mastered {SKILL}. Now I want to teach it to anyone who'll listen.

gloomy.li: I'm a master of {SKILL} now. I thought I'd feel more different than I do.

blunt.li: Master of {SKILL}. Took long enough. Now stop asking me for tips while I'm working.

cold.li: Mastery of {SKILL}. There's always a level beyond this one, and I'll find it.

plain.li: [sparked] I stood at that wedding and wanted the same for myself, someone who'd promise to stay.
[inherited] All that talk from {NAME} about a wedding with flowers from the fields, and it never happened. I mean to {GOAL}, and there will be flowers.
I'd like to get married. Out here on the Rim, of all places.
I want a wedding, with flowers and too much food and people crying.
[old] They say it's never too late. I'd better marry while I can still dance at my own wedding.

blunt.li: I want to marry. Don't make it weird.

gloomy.li: I'd like to marry someone before this place takes everything else from me.

warm.li: I want to promise someone forever, with all our friends there to see it.

plain.li: I'm married. I keep looking at my hand. I'm married.
We said our vows by the storeroom door, because that's where the light was best.
[winter] A winter wedding. Snow in my hair, cold hands in mine. I wouldn't have had it any other way.

cheerful.li: I'm married! I'm going to tell every trader who comes through.

cold.li: Married. It's a contract, and I intend to honor every term of it.

warm.li: We're married. Even the ones who can't dance got up and danced.

plain.li: [spark:birth] I held the new baby today. I want one of my own. I didn't know how much until now.
[inherited] {NAME} wanted children so badly. I'm going to {GOAL}, and if I can, the baby will carry {NAME}'s name.
I've started thinking about a child of my own, someone to teach and to carry on after me.
One day I'd like to hear a baby crying in this colony and know it's mine.

gloomy.li: Even here, I want a child. One of us ought to leave more behind than graves.
[afterraid] We fought so hard for this place. Someone should inherit it. I want a child.

warm.li: I want to teach someone small how to plant a seed and wait for it. I want a child of my own.

plain.li: I held my child today. Everything I've ever worried about rearranged itself in one second.
I'm a parent now, and I have no idea what I'm doing.
[night] It's the middle of the night, the baby is finally asleep on my chest, and I'm too happy to move.

warm.li: My child is here. I'll spend the rest of my life making this place good enough for them.

cheerful.li: A baby, with tiny fingers! I'm never sleeping again and I don't care.

plain.li: [sparked] I've been alone too long. I don't want to die with nobody at my grave who really knew me.
[inherited] I didn't see how lonely {NAME} was until too late. I'll {GOAL}, and I won't let anyone else eat alone.
I want real friends here. The kind you'd run back into a fire for.
[newcomer] I'm new here and everyone already has their people. I'd like three friends of my own.

blunt.li: I'm told I'm hard to like. I'll find three people who disagree.

gloomy.li: I'm lonely. There, I wrote it. I'm going to do something about it.

cheerful.li: I'm going to make three best friends! I'll be so friendly they won't stand a chance.

plain.li: Three people I'd trust with my life, and who'd trust me with theirs.

warm.li: I have true friends here. I didn't have that before. I'll never take it for granted.

cheerful.li: I have three best friends now! We sit together at every meal.

blunt.li: Three real friends. I'm not as hard to like as they said.

gloomy.li: I have three true friends now, which means three people I'm afraid of losing.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a student
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: train a student until they can stand alone

plain.li: [sparked] Someone took the time to teach me. Now I want to do the same for someone else.
[inherited] {NAME} had so much to pass on and no one to pass it to. I'll {GOAL} and teach them what {NAME} taught me.
I learned most of what I know by getting it wrong. I'd like to spare someone a few of those mistakes.
I've got a head full of tricks and no one to give them to. It's time I took a student.
[old] My hands are slowing down. Before they stop, I want someone else to know what they know.

cold.li: If I die, everything I know dies with me. That's poor planning. I'll train a successor.

cheerful.li: I'm going to take on a student! I'll make little practice sheets.

plain.li: My student doesn't need me anymore. I watched them work today and had nothing to correct.

warm.li: My student is ready. Whatever I've done wrong in my life, I did this right.

cold.li: My student outperformed me today, exactly as planned. I am entirely calm about it.

cheerful.li: My student is ready! I may have hugged them too hard.

plain.li: [spark:loss] We buried someone today, and all I could think about was the feud I'm wasting my life on. I want to end it.
[inherited] {NAME} died still angry at someone. I don't want to go the same way, so I'm going to {GOAL} while there's time.
I'm tired of being angry all the time. I want to end at least one of my feuds.

warm.li: Someone here hates me and I hate them back. I want to fix that. I don't know how yet.

gloomy.li: If I died tomorrow, the last thing someone said to me might be an insult. I want to fix that while I can.

cold.li: This feud costs us both time and focus. Ending it is the rational choice. I'll find a way.

plain.li: We're done fighting. I didn't realize how heavy it was until I put it down.

blunt.li: The feud's over. I won't say I miss it.

warm.li: We talked until the candle burned down. We wanted the same things all along.

cheerful.li: We shook hands, then both apologized at the same time and laughed!

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a seat on the council
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: earn a seat on the council

plain.li: [sparked] They voted for someone else. Next time, they won't.
[inherited] {NAME} would have been good on the council. I'll {GOAL} and argue for the things {NAME} wanted.
I have ideas for this colony, and a seat on the council is the only way they'll get heard.
[doubtful] I don't trust the council. So I'm going to join it and see for myself what goes on in there.

cold.li: Influence requires office. I'll be elected.

cheerful.li: I'm going to run for the council! I've already got a slogan, though it needs work.

blunt.li: The council keeps getting it wrong. I'd get it right. Time to get myself elected.

plain.li: They chose me. I have a seat on the council now. I'm going to try very hard not to waste it.

cheerful.li: I'm on the council! It's the same chair I always sat in, but it feels different now.

cold.li: Seat secured. I have a list of what to change first.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a room worth living in
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: have a bedroom fit for a noble

plain.li: [sparked] Another night on the floor with a dozen snorers. One day I'll have a room so fine people stop at the door.
[inherited] Every night in the barracks, {NAME} described the room we'd all have one day. I'm going to {GOAL}, just the way {NAME} described it.
I've slept in holes my whole life. Before I die, I want a bedroom with a proper bed, a rug and something nice on the wall.
[trait:Greedy] Everyone else can sleep in a barracks. I want a room fit for a lord, with carpets, and a lock.

cheerful.li: One day my room will have a chandelier! I don't know what one costs, and I don't care.

blunt.li: I'm tired of waking up to somebody else's snoring. I want a room, a proper one, and I want it nice.

plain.li: I stood in my doorway tonight just looking at it. My room. The finest one I've ever had.
[winter] Snow outside, and me warm in the finest room I've ever slept in. I'm never leaving it.

gloomy.li: A beautiful room. If I die tomorrow, at least it'll be in comfort.

cheerful.li: My room is beautiful! I've been giving tours to anyone who walks past.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a name to remember
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: earn a name the colony remembers

plain.li: [inherited] If anyone here deserved a title, it was {NAME}. I'll {GOAL}, and every time I hear it I'll think of {NAME}.
The others have names. "The Healer." "Deadeye." I want one. A good one, ideally.
When people tell stories about this colony one day, I'd like to come up in them.

blunt.li: I want a title. I'll earn it.

cheerful.li: I want a nickname, a heroic one with "the" in it!

gloomy.li: When I'm gone, I want people to say more than my name. I want them to say what I was.

plain.li: They have a name for me now. I heard someone use it when they didn't know I was listening.

cheerful.li: I have a title now! I'm going to sign everything with it.

warm.li: They call me by a name I earned now. Every time I hear it, I want to deserve it more.

cold.li: An epithet has been assigned. It is accurate. I approve.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: to endure
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: live to see three more years here

plain.li: [spark:downed] I lay in the dirt and thought that was the end. It wasn't. I want every year I can get now.
[inherited] {NAME} didn't get the years. I'm going to {GOAL} and count every one of them as {NAME}'s too.
People don't last long out here. I mean to last three more years, at least.
[old] I've outlived most of the people I started out with. Three more years. Then I'll negotiate for three more.

gloomy.li: Three more years without dying. It sounds simple enough written down.

cheerful.li: Three more years here! I'm going to be so alive.

plain.li: Three more years. I've outlasted two roofs and three cooks.
[hurt] Three years. I've got a scar for every one of them. Still here.

cold.li: Survival objective met. Setting a new one.

warm.li: Three more years with these people. I'd sign up for three more right now if anyone was offering.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a growing colony
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see the colony grow to {COUNT} people

plain.li: [spark:birth] A baby was born here today. I'd like to see this colony full of children.
[inherited] {NAME} used to count the empty beds and talk about who might fill them one day. I'll {GOAL}.
I'd like to see this place full, with noise at dinner and arguments over chores, like a real town.

warm.li: I want so many people here I forget some of their names. Then I'll learn them all again.

cheerful.li: Enough neighbors that we need a second dining room! And then a third.

cold.li: Small colonies die of one bad season. I want to see us grow out of that danger.

plain.li: I counted heads at dinner. We're a real colony now. I remember when we were three tired people and a campfire.

warm.li: A full table at dinner, and more faces than I can count at a glance. I love every one of them, even the new ones I haven't met properly.

cheerful.li: We're a real colony! I had to learn three new names this week.

plain.li: [spark:battle] I saw what they did on the wall today. They'll keep coming. I'll keep counting.
[inherited] When the raiders came, {NAME} held the wall longer than any of us. Now I'll {GOAL}, carrying {NAME}'s weapon.
The raiders keep coming. Fine. I'm going to be the reason they stop.
[trait:Bloodlust] Every raid is a gift. I want to unwrap twenty-five of them.

blunt.li: They come to take what's ours. I'll make sure twenty-five of them don't leave.

plain.li: Twenty-five. I've stopped counting faces. I haven't stopped counting.
[trait:Brawler] Twenty-five. Most of them up close, where I could see their eyes. That's how it should be done.

blunt.li: Twenty-five down. They can keep sending more.

cold.li: Twenty-five hostiles neutralized. The count continues.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a builder's legacy
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: raise a hundred and fifty structures

plain.li: [inherited] Half the walls here went up under {NAME}'s hands. I'll {GOAL}, starting with the ones {NAME} left unfinished.
One day I'd like to walk through this colony and see my work in every wall, door and roof.
[tribal] Our ancestors raised great halls of timber and stone. I want to raise this place the same way, wall by wall.
I like the sound a wall makes when the last piece goes in. I'd like to hear it a hundred and fifty times.

cheerful.li: A hundred and fifty things built by me: walls, beds and one really nice door!

plain.li: I walked the whole colony today and touched everything I built. It took hours.

warm.li: Everyone here sleeps under a roof I put up. That's the best feeling I know.

blunt.li: A hundred and fifty structures, all built right and all still standing.

plain.li: [spark:downed] Someone stitched me up when I was bleeding out. I want to be that person for someone else.
[inherited] A lot of us are only alive because of {NAME}'s needle and steady hands. I'm going to {GOAL} and try to be half as calm about it.
Every scar in this colony should have my stitches in it. A hundred wounds. Then I'll call myself a healer.
[afterraid] I spent all night after the raid with my hands in other people's blood. I want to get good enough that I lose fewer of them.

warm.li: I don't want anyone bleeding alone out here while I'm around.

cold.li: Tending wounds is a skill of repetition. A hundred cases should be sufficient to perfect it.

plain.li: A hundred wounds closed. I remember most of them. I remember all of the ones I lost.

warm.li: A hundred wounds tended. Every one of them was someone's whole world for a moment. I'm honored.

gloomy.li: A hundred wounds. The ones I couldn't save are the ones I see when I close my eyes.

plain.li: [sparked] That meal last night made everyone go quiet. I want to cook like that.
[inherited] I can still taste {NAME}'s stew. I'm going to {GOAL}, and sooner or later I'll get that recipe right.
Five hundred meals. When I've cooked that many, I'll call myself a cook.
[trait:Gourmand] I love food more than I love most people. Time to share that love around. Five hundred meals.

cheerful.li: Five hundred meals! That's a lot of full stomachs.

blunt.li: The food here is bad. I'm going to fix it, five hundred plates at a time.

plain.li: Five hundred meals. Someone asked for seconds tonight. Still the best part.

warm.li: Five hundred meals. I know everyone's favorite now. I make it for them on bad days.

cheerful.li: Five hundred meals, and only two small kitchen fires!

plain.li: [inherited] The animals still wait by the gate for {NAME}. I'll {GOAL}, and I'll be as patient with them as {NAME} was.
Wild animals don't trust people, and they're right not to. I'd like five of them to trust me anyway.
There's a muffalo that's been grazing by the fields all week, watching us. I'd like to start with that one.

warm.li: Everything wild out there is scared or hungry or both. I want to show five of them they don't have to be.

cheerful.li: Five new animal friends! I've already picked too many names for them.

plain.li: Five wild animals that would follow me anywhere now. One of them sleeps across my doorway.

blunt.li: Five tamed. They listen better than most of you.

warm.li: Five wild hearts trust me now. I'll never give them a reason not to.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a voice that wins people over
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: win three prisoners over to the colony

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} believed anyone could be talked round, even the ones in our cells. I'll {GOAL} and prove {NAME} right.
Everyone we lock up was someone once. I want to talk three of them into being someone here.

warm.li: Some of the people in our cells just need someone to listen. I'm going to sit with three of them until they want to stay.

cold.li: Each prisoner is a potential asset. I will convert three.

plain.li: Three people who came here in chains now eat at our table. I talked them into it. I'm proud of that.

cheerful.li: Three new friends who used to be prisoners! I'm the best talker on the Rim.

gloomy.li: Three people won over. Some nights I wonder if I talked them into a better life or just a different cage.

plain.li: [inherited] Some mornings {NAME} would tell us what was coming, and sometimes it came. I'm going to {GOAL}, and write each dream down the way {NAME} did.
My grandmother dreamt things before they happened. I want to know if I can too.
[night] I woke from a dream so vivid I wrote it down in the dark. I want to know if any of this means anything.

cold.li: I'll keep a record of my dreams and test them against events. For science.

cheerful.li: I'm going to dream the future! I've been sleeping a lot, for practice.

plain.li: It came true. My dream came true. I don't know whether to be proud or frightened.

cold.li: A dream preceded the event with enough accuracy to rule out chance. Mostly. I'm troubled.

gloomy.li: My dream came true. I wish it had been a happier one.

plain.li: [spark:loss] They killed someone I loved. Now I know what I'm living for.
[inherited] {NAME} wanted them to pay, and died before they did. I'll {GOAL}, for {NAME} as well.
I don't care about comfort anymore, or peace. I'm going to find the ones who did this.
I sat at the grave until dark and made a promise. I intend to keep it.
[lowmood] I can't sleep. I can't eat. The only thing I can think about is making them pay.

warm.li: I don't want to be the kind of person who lives for revenge. Right now, I am.

cold.li: One objective. It will be met.

blunt.li: They took someone from me. I'm going to take something back.

plain.li: It's done. I went back to the grave and said so out loud.

gloomy.li: Avenged. I waited so long to feel this. It feels like nothing much.

cold.li: The debt is paid. I feel nothing in particular. I expected that.

warm.li: It's over. I hope the dead can rest now. I hope I can.
